card.name: Verbs and adjectives before physical scene nouns
card.fires_on: Verbs, prepositions or adjectives in general web prose that come just before a physical object or place noun, as in craft steps, bow stringing, or landscape description.

modes.label: Placement verbs in how-to steps
modes.description: Verbs like put, place, go or on that tell where to set a physical object.
modes.example: leaving the tail unglued.<< Put>> the two pieces of tissue together and let

modes.label: Scenic adjectives or prepositions
modes.description: Words like beautiful, through or at that lead into a description of scenery or events.
modes.example: tundra and<< beautiful>> glaciers that spawn crystal-colored icebergs

card.plain: It fires on small words that come right before a physical thing or place in everyday descriptions and instructions.
